"After the Well of the Wolf," he says, "the Devils could no longer remain in the sight of the Judgements: not if we intended to live. We escaped through Caduceus into Parabola, the place that is not; and from there onward. We were a people in exile. Not strong enough to take a place and hold it for our own. Not weak enough to be welcomed as refugees. It was an intolerable time and I take no pleasure in remembering it.",“经过狼之井一役，”他说，“魔鬼们不能继续留在司命的视线之内：如果我们还想保命的话。我们经过双蛇杖逃进帕布拉，那个不存在的地方；从那里继续迁移。我们是一个流亡的民族。我们不够强大，没法占领一片土地，将其据为己有。我们也不够弱小，无法作为难民受到欢迎。那段历史让人无法忍受，我不愿回想。”
